description: R-PAR-1 PAR-ORDER, SQL-REL: Without ORDER BY, in what order do the 256 rows of OT5 (no key, no index), OT2 (primary key descending in insertion), OT3 (index on k) and OT4 (compound index on k, ins DESC) come out of SELECT ins FROM table (one GetRows(300) per table)? Runs on a fresh copy of r-par-1-order opened read-only through DAO OpenDatabase in one process and one STA; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, and every call's result, HRESULT and DBEngine.Errors are captured.
